Sam (AE): Hey team — Aurion asked for a short perf POC next week. They want sustained 200 qps for text-generation (max 512 tokens) with <200ms p95 and an option to burst to 800 qps for 2 mins. Can we confirm feasibility and a runbook?
Olivia (SRE): 200 qps sustained at 512 tokens is doable on Dedicated n4 if we batch. Need to know model variant (fp16 or int8) and KV cache warmup plan.
Mitesh (Solutions): Aurion prefers an open model (distil-llama-13b int8) — cost sensitive. They asked whether Redwood hosted can hit burst without capacity reservation.
Jordan (Pricing): Hosted can burst but pricing gets spiky; recommend reserved for predictable cost. I can sketch cost delta: hosted burst vs reserved monthly commit.
Sam (AE): They also raised KMS/HSM requirement for encryption keys — could that add latency?
Leah (Security): HSM adds extra RTT on key unwrap for each model load if keys are fetched on coldstart. For steady-state inference keys are cached in the runtime, so impact is negligible on per-token latency. We should document key-cache behavior for Aurion's compliance team.
Olivia (SRE): Runbook proposal:
- Stage 0: smoke (10 qps, 1 min) to validate routing and auth
- Stage 1: ramp to 50 qps, 5m samples
- Stage 2: sustained 200 qps for 20m with 30s KV-prewarm phase
- Stage 3: 4x burst test to 800 qps for 2m, then fallback to 200 qps for 10m
- Observability checks: p50/p95/p99, GPU util, request/response byte sizes, error rate
Sam (AE): Nice. Can we add a quick script for them to run load from their side? Something lightweight.
Mitesh (Solutions): Suggest vegeta or hey. Example vegeta command we can give:
```bash
echo '{"input": "summarize: write a one paragraph summary"}' > payload.json
vegeta attack -header "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -duration 2m -rate 200 -body payload.json http://redwood.api/v1/generate | vegeta report
```
Olivia (SRE): Will add instructions to rotate keys mid-test to verify no interruption. Also include curl example for single-request latency checks.
Jordan (Pricing): FYI Aurion asked for a ballpark per-1M-token cost at int8 on hosted vs dedicated commit. I'll send a table after we finalize qps/profile.
Leah (Security): Two questionnaire items we need to answer for them: 1) Are private keys exported from our control plane? 2) Do we keep KMS logs for 12 months? I can draft answers and attach standard attestation.
Sam (AE): Blockers: Aurion insists on HSM-backed keys + SOC2 addendum — can we get legal to approve fast?
Mitesh (Solutions): Legal usually needs the SOC2 addendum template; I'll ping Legal and link to the exact clause. For HSM we offer customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; for Hosted we use Redwood-managed KMS with HSM-backed providers — Leah can confirm.
Leah (Security): Confirm: Hosted uses HSM-backed provider (no key export), but not customer-owned HSM. That may be a dealbreaker for them. We should present Dedicated or Private as options and show latency tradeoffs.
Olivia (SRE): On latency: expected p95 numbers (estimates)
- Hosted int8 (shared, burst): p95 ≈ 180–260 ms (depending on noisy neighbors)
- Dedicated int8 (reserved pool): p95 ≈ 120–160 ms
- Private on-prem (customer infra): depends on HW; we should run their sample if they provide instance details
Sam (AE): Great. Can someone draft the email to Aurion with runbook + quick checklist + pricing delta? Keep it short.
Jordan (Pricing): I'll draft pricing bullets: hosted burst rate, reserved monthly commitment tier pricing, and estimated 1M-token cost in both modes.
Mitesh (Solutions): I'll prep the vegeta payloads and an automated post-test diagnostic script that uploads a small ZIP of traces (logs, vegeta report, GPU metrics) to the shared drive.
Olivia (SRE): Also recommend enabling prefix KV caching for their workload — if they have repeated prompts, we can shave ~15–30% off token cost and tail latency. Note: requires pinned model version.
Sam (AE): Action items recap: Jordan pricing draft by EOD; Mitesh run artifacts + diagnostic script by tomorrow AM; Leah security FAQ + attestation by tomorrow noon; Olivia runbook + vegeta/curl snippets + expected p95 table by tomorrow AM. I'll coordinate with Aurion to schedule wed/thursday testing windows.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance: planned infra update in us-west-2 on Wed 03:00-04:00 UTC — may affect hosted burst capacity.
Sam (AE): Good catch — I'll avoid scheduling tests during that window and let Aurion know.
Mitesh (Solutions): One more question — do we want to run a control test against an identical model on a single dedicated node to baseline byte-to-latency curves?
Olivia (SRE): Yes, baseline helps. We'll include a 10-min single-node run at 50 qps for comparison.
Sam (AE): Perfect. If nobody objects I'll send the summary to Aurion and loop Legal on SOC2 addendum. :thumbsup:
